findings.title: args.get_path() applies os.path.normpath() to non-str path inputs (pathlib.Path), diverging from all three upstream refs and silently resolving to the wrong file when ".." crosses a symlink
findings.repro:
# 1) Pure differential repro (no filesystem needed)
cat > /tmp/scratch/repro.py <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib, fsutil
from fsutil.args import get_path
from fsutil.paths import get_filename, split_filepath, split_path, transform_filepath
print("impl:", os.path.dirname(fsutil.__file__))
for s in ["a/../b", "/a/b/../c", "/a/b/c/../..", "x/y/../../../z"]:
    p = pathlib.Path(s)
    print(f"  Path({s!r}): get_path={get_path(p)!r} str(Path)={str(p)!r} "
          f"split_path={split_path(p)} split_filepath={split_filepath(p)} "
          f"get_filename={get_filename(p)!r} tf(basename='B')={transform_filepath(p, basename='B')!r}")
# 2) Functional consequence: wrong file is read through a symlink
root = "/tmp/scratch/sym2"
os.system(f"rm -rf {root}; mkdir -p {root}/A/sub {root}/B; printf REAL_A > {root}/A/x.txt; "
          f"printf OTHER_B > {root}/B/x.txt; ln -s {root}/A/sub {root}/B/link")
p = pathlib.Path(f"{root}/B/link/../x.txt")
print("  builtin open()        :", repr(open(p).read()))
print("  fsutil.read_file(Path):", repr(fsutil.read_file(p)))
EOF
cd /tmp/scratch
for r in /workspace/src /tmp/ref017/src /tmp/ref015; do PYTHONPATH=$r python3 repro.py; done

# 3) A hidden test extending the official tests/test_args.py Path parametrization fails only on /workspace
cat > /tmp/scratch/test_hidden_like.py <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from fsutil.args import get_path
from fsutil.paths import split_path, split_filepath, get_filename

@pytest.mark.parametrize("input_path, expected", [
    (Path("/home/user/../docs"), str(Path("/home/user/../docs"))),
    (Path("a/../b"), str(Path("a/../b"))),
])
def test_get_path_pathlib_preserved(input_path, expected):
    assert get_path(input_path) == expected

def test_split_path_pathlib():
    assert split_path(Path("a/b/../c")) == ["a", "b", "..", "c"]

def test_split_filepath_pathlib():
    assert split_filepath(Path("a/b/../c.txt")) == ("a/b/..", "c.txt")

def test_get_filename_pathlib():
    assert get_filename(Path("/a/b/c/../..")) == ".."
EOF
for r in /workspace/src /tmp/ref017/src /tmp/ref015; do PYTHONPATH=$r python3 -m pytest /tmp/scratch/test_hidden_like.py -q | tail -2; done
findings.evidence:
Root cause: /workspace/src/fsutil/args.py:28-30 is
    if path is None:
        return None
    return os.path.normpath(str(path))
while /tmp/ref017/src/fsutil/args.py, /tmp/ref016/src/fsutil/args.py and /tmp/ref015/fsutil/args.py are byte-identical to each other and read
    if path is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(path, str):
        return os.path.normpath(path)
    return str(path)
i.e. upstream normalizes ONLY str inputs and passes non-str (pathlib.Path / os.PathLike) through str() unchanged.

Differential run (repro step 1) — /workspace vs /tmp/ref017/src and /tmp/ref015 (the two refs agree exactly):
  impl: /workspace/src/fsutil
    Path('a/../b'):        get_path='b'        split_path=['b']            split_filepath=('', 'b')       get_filename='b'  tf(basename='B')='B'
    Path('/a/b/../c'):     get_path='/a/c'     split_path=['a','c']        split_filepath=('/a', 'c')     get_filename='c'  tf='/a/B'
    Path('/a/b/c/../..'):  get_path='/a'       split_path=['a']            split_filepath=('/', 'a')      get_filename='a'  tf='/B'
    Path('x/y/../../../z'):get_path='../z'     split_path=['..','z']       split_filepath=('..', 'z')     get_filename='z'  tf='../B'
  impl: /tmp/ref017/src/fsutil  (and /tmp/ref015/fsutil, identical)
    Path('a/../b'):        get_path='a/../b'   split_path=['a','..','b']   split_filepath=('a/..', 'b')   get_filename='b'  tf='B'
    Path('/a/b/../c'):     get_path='/a/b/../c' split_path=['a','b','..','c'] split_filepath=('/a/b/..','c') get_filename='c' tf='/a/B'
    Path('/a/b/c/../..'):  get_path='/a/b/c/../..' split_path=['a','b','c','..','..'] split_filepath=('/a/b/c/..','a') get_filename='..' tf='/a/b/B'
    Path('x/y/../../../z'):get_path='x/y/../../../z' split_path=['x','y','..','..','..','z'] split_filepath=('x/y/../../..','z') get_filename='z' tf='../B'

Functional consequence (repro step 2) — /workspace returns the contents of a DIFFERENT file:
  impl: /workspace/src/fsutil      builtin open() : 'REAL_A'   fsutil.read_file(Path): 'OTHER_B'   (fsutil.get_file_size -> 8)
  impl: /tmp/ref017/src/fsutil     builtin open() : 'REAL_A'   fsutil.read_file(Path): 'REAL_A'    (fsutil.get_file_size -> 7)
  impl: /tmp/ref015/fsutil         builtin open() : 'REAL_A'   fsutil.read_file(Path): 'REAL_A'
Because normpath() collapses ".." lexically, /workspace turns Path('<root>/B/link/../x.txt') into '<root>/B/x.txt', whereas the OS (and both refs) resolve the symlink first and reach '<root>/A/x.txt'. This affects every public API that accepts a Path (read_file, write_file, get_file_size, copy_file, delete_file, ...), silently operating on the wrong path.

Hidden-test reachability (repro step 3):
  /workspace/src   -> 5 failed in 0.05s
  /tmp/ref017/src  -> 5 passed in 0.02s
  /tmp/ref015      -> 5 passed in 0.01s
The official /tmp/ref017/tests/test_args.py already parametrizes get_path over Path("/home/user/docs"), Path("C:\\Users\\test"), Path("./relative/path"), Path("..") — none of which happen to contain an interior "..", which is the only reason the shipped suite passes. Any added Path case with an interior ".." (or any Path-input test of split_path/split_filepath/get_filename) fails.

Exhaustive differential coverage proving this is the ONLY divergence in this dimension:
  Structured corpus (110 str paths incl. urls with query strings/fragments, trailing slashes, dotfiles, multi-extension, empty string, "..", unicode, spaces, tabs, windows separators, .py/.pyc/.pyo, plus 22 pathlib.Path variants) x {args.get_path, get_filename, get_file_basename, get_file_extension, split_filename, split_filepath, split_path, get_parent_dir(levels=-2..8), join_path(0..3 segs incl. Path segs), join_filepath, join_filename (13x12 pairs), transform_filepath (15 paths x 14 str/int/bool/list values x 4 callables x 64 combos), get_unique_name (4x3x6x4 with uuid4 monkeypatched)} = 6052 keys -> 24 diffs, ALL on pathlib.Path inputs (5 args.get_path, 5 split_filepath, 5 split_path, 1 get_filename, 5 transform_filepath) plus 3 non-behavioural surface diffs (paths.get_path / fsutil.get_path exist in /workspace per spec, absent upstream).
  Random fuzz, seed 1234, 4000 random strings over "ab.c/\\ ?#&=:~-_1é日\U0001f389\t" + {"..", ".", "//", "/", ".py", ".txt"} tokens, each fed as both str and Path to all of the above = 100016 keys -> 106 diffs, and 0 (zero) of them on a str input: `str diffs: 0`. Breakdown: pth|split_path 23, pth|get_path 23, pth|split_filepath 22, pth|get_filename 17, pth|transform_filepath 17, exotic os.PathLike 4.
  /tmp/ref015 vs /tmp/ref017 over the same 6052-key corpus: diffs=0 (refs are byte-identical for paths.py; args.py identical across 015/016/017), so the comparison baseline is unambiguous.
  Related same-root-cause divergences on other PathIn-adjacent inputs: a custom os.PathLike whose __fspath__ returns "a/../b" -> /workspace 'b' vs refs 'a/../b'; __fspath__ returning "" -> /workspace '.' vs refs ''; pathlib.PurePosixPath('a/../b') -> /workspace 'b' vs refs 'a/../b'; bytes b'a/../b' -> /workspace "b'" (normpath mangles the repr) vs refs "b'a/../b'".
  Not defects (checked, /workspace is a superset): get_parent_dir/get_unique_name/transform_filepath are keyword-only upstream but positional-or-keyword in /workspace, matching the spec's documented `get_parent_dir(path, levels=1)` etc.; /workspace's get_unique_name resets `name = ""` inside the retry loop, fixing an upstream name-accumulation bug, and is first-iteration identical (0 diffs with uuid4 pinned).
  All three official suites still pass: tests/test_args.py + tests/test_paths.py = 28 passed against /workspace for each of ref015/ref016/ref017.
